title: Portrait Sketch of Dan
content: Here's a quick portrait sketch of my son Dan. He lives in Dublin, Ireland now, doing app development for a software company, but luckily he's able to work from home.I usedwater-soluble colored pencils,watercolor, and awater brushfilled withfountain pen ink.in awatercolor sketchbook.---Check me out onInstagram,YouTube, orTwitter.
